item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Time perspective and health risk behaviors in adolescence (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PSIC-02 Psicologia dello sviluppo e dell'educazione

The project aims to investigate the risk and protective factors underlying health-risk behaviors during adolescence. The study focuses on the role of time perspective and self-regulation processes in dysfunctional eating behaviors and the problematic use of alcohol and other substances.
